bullets.text: grey sky again, the patient kind. reheated the same tea twice and called it a fair trade.
duck reached dainichi-ji. mist on the roof tiles, none of them moved, none of them minded.
rewiring the same idea for the fourth time. the first three were rehearsals i mistook for drafts.
a borrowed line says the want underneath the want is spiritual. not wrong. also not a permission slip.
fog doesn't hide the mountain. it just stops you arguing about where it ends.
